releaseGate.reason: The owned source and minimal runtime profile are assembled, but the completion candidate still requires fresh exact Cyberpunk 2077 2.31 compilation, attended native gameplay/save/quest/performance acceptance, final calibration and final archive/notices/checksum verification before a public playable release.

components.notes: Only the accepted runtime payload belongs in a player artifact; tests, reports, staging and source-only tooling stay out.

The current owned candidate uses REDscript as its only generic runtime/compiler plumbing. Bundle the pinned official Windows payload and required MIT notice in the final one-download package after live acceptance.
No current realpass production source imports RED4ext APIs and the owned live-test profile no longer stages it.
No current realpass production source/resource path requires ArchiveXL.
No current realpass production source/data path requires TweakXL.
The owned dynamic Biology/nameplate UI uses native Ink/REDscript APIs and has no Codeware import.
Core gameplay configuration is a locked authored experience; the retired player gameplay-settings surface is not a runtime dependency.
The current owned runtime adds no custom input binding requiring Input Loader.
Historical research/provenance may remain in the repository, but executing Dark Future content is forbidden from owned/live/public realpass candidates.
Accepted presentation behavior is now recreated with realpass-owned source plus stock Cyberpunk UI. Original/modified Project E3 runtime assets remain forbidden from the standalone artifact.
No Cyberpunk executable, stock archives, compiled cache, saves or user settings enter a realpass artifact.

artifactRequirements: Game-root-relative paths only for runtime payload.
The final artifact contains only allowed runtime components: project-original realpass payload plus the pinned redscript runtime selected by the release profile.
A short INSTALL.txt at the archive root explains game-root extraction, ordinary Steam launch and uninstall/repair expectations.
A VERSION/BUILD identifier and SHA-256 checksum are generated deterministically.
Required redscript MIT notice and realpass notices are included without development-only files.
The artifact content list is generated and verified before upload.
Blocked or not-required components cause the public-playable release job to fail closed rather than silently expanding the dependency stack.
